purpose: Human-reviewed evidence pack that keeps Daniel–Moskowitz recovery crash, Khandani–Lo crowded unwind, and fundamental repricing separate.
scope_constraints: Evidence cannot change deterministic values, thresholds, labels, risk states, or PM response categories.
No item published after the cutoff may support the May 29 assessment.
A correlated-theme proxy is not an observed common-ownership or semiconductor classification.
No causality, probability, or trade recommendation is produced.

timestamp_rules.exact: Use only when the source states an offset-aware time.
timestamp_rules.date: Use YYYY-MM-DD when only a publication date is reliably available; do not invent a time.
timestamp_rules.month: Insufficient for inclusion when the month overlaps the cutoff; mark timestamp_uncertain.
timestamp_rules.future: Any publication after the cutoff is excluded even if it describes the assessment period.

passage_rules: Store only the minimum passage needed for review.
Paraphrase where practical and never store a full copyrighted article.
The content_hash is SHA-256 over the UTF-8 passage exactly as stored.
Every supporting passage must be traceable to url_or_locator.
human_review_rule: Candidate mechanism labels and directions are research hypotheses only. Annotation CSV semantic fields remain blank until reviewed.
